snippet.title: Lethal Enforcers II: Gun Fighters (Arcade) Full Walkthrough with cheats
snippet.description:
Played by BoricuaRetroGamer/Kasumi77
Lethal Enforcers II: Gun Fighters (Arcade) Full Walkthrough with cheats

Welcome back with more Arcade longplays with cheats!!
Yeeeeeee-haaaw!! We are now going waaaaay back to the past: in the 1873!
You're a sheriff and your mission is to kill as many enemies as you can.
Introducing the Lethal Enforcers II: Gun Fighters in Japan aka Lethal Enforcers II: Old Western in the US. It was developed and published by the people of Konami in 1994 and released on SNES, Arcade and on Sega Genesis and it's also a light gun shooter in first person perspective.
This is my first time of playing, so don't judge me.
Hope you enjoy it!
